'''''Platanus rzedowskii''''', commonly known as '''Rzedowski's plane tree''', '''Rzedowski's sycamore''',<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Platanus rzedowskii Nixon & J.M.Poole {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:60429577-2 |access-date=2023-05-06 |website=Plants of the World Online |language=en}}</ref> '''Sicómoro de la Sierra Madre Occidental''', or the '''Sierra Madre Occidental sycamore''',<ref name=":1">{{Cite journal |last=IUCN |date=2020-10-21 |title=Platanus rzedowskii: Fuentes, A.C.D., Martínez Salas, E. & Samain, M.-S.: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species 2021: e.T126609169A126609878 |url=https://www.iucnredlist.org/species/126609169/126609878 |language=en |doi=10.2305/iucn.uk.2021-1.rlts.t126609169a126609878.en|s2cid=242734080 |doi-access=free }}</ref> is a species of ''[[Platanus]]'' in the family [[Platanaceae]]. It was described by [[Jackie M. Poole]] in 2003 with the name attributed to [[Kevin C. Nixon]].<ref name=":0" />

== Description ==
''Platanus rzedowskii'' on average reaches 80 ft (24 meters) or more, with a 30 ft (9 meters) width. [[Leaf|Leaves]] are 8 in (20 centimeters) wide, and olive green, turning a yellow-green during the winter months. [[Root]]s are vast, and grow particularly to enormous degrees. [[Flower]]s are white, bloom December through February, [[fruiting]] occurs April through August months.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=ENH1241/EP502: Rzedowski's Sycamore (Platanus rzedowskii), a Smaller Alternative to American Sycamore |url=https://edis.ifas.ufl.edu/publication/EP502 |access-date=2023-05-06 |website=edis.ifas.ufl.edu |language=en}}</ref>

== Distribution and habitat ==
''Platanus rzedowskii'' is [[Endemism|endemic]] to northeastern [[Mexico]], primarily parts of [[Nuevo León]], [[San Luis Potosí]], and [[Tamaulipas]] at 45–1,300 m [[elevation]], where it grows in [[Arid|drier-climate]] conditions based on its range [[geography]]. It grows between and beside another almost identical species, ''[[Platanus mexicana]]''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Platanus rzedowskii {{!}} International Plant Names Index |url=https://www.ipni.org/n/60429577-2 |access-date=2023-05-06 |website=www.ipni.org}}</ref>

== Conservation ==
''Platanus rzedowskii'' is listed as "[[Least-concern species|Least Concern]]" by the [[IUCN Red List]],<ref name=":1" /> for there are no serious threats to the species besides two species of [[fungus]], [[Canker|anthracnose]] and [[powdery mildew]].<ref name=":2" /> Other threats may include, [[deforestation]], [[wildfire]]s, and [[Human development (economics)|human development]], but are generally mild in the case that they are not as common of threats.<ref name=":1" />

== Uses ==
''Platanus rzedowskii'' has no other current uses besides being used as an [[Ornamental plant|ornamental tree]], or its wood being harvested for [[Commerce (disambiguation)|commerce]]. [[Indigenous peoples of Mexico|Native Americans]] may have used the species for [[medication|medical remedies]] in its range, but no evidence is clear on that discussion.<ref name=":2" />
